# libsgp4

This directory contains the `libsgp4` satellite-propagation library by Daniel
Warner, vendored from:

<https://github.com/dnwrnr/sgp4>

Source revision: `d176906dbfaf8361eee1f83bd1dc1bacc6582798` (2025-11-03).

The upstream `.cc` translation units are named `.cpp` here so UnrealBuildTool
compiles them as part of the game module. Their source contents and license
notices are otherwise unchanged. The upstream Apache-2.0 license is included
as `LICENSE` in this directory.
